# SocialUs today: what you can do

**As of 2026-10-23** · Source: criterion roll-up (195 of 291 criteria built), closed Issues · Generated by: `write-launch-report` · Version: pre-beta · Doc: https://claude.ai/artifact/RRuB51udiVHs8A5P1P9tua

- Sign in with your email and a six-digit code; there is no password to remember.
- Your zip code picks your local market, and nobody else ever sees your zip.
- Start something in your town without opening a shop or filling in business forms.
- Create a Page by answering one question: what kind of thing it is.
- Agree to a short set of community rules, with the reason for each, before you publish.
- Post to a Page you manage, with a time on it if it has one; undated posts leave Explore after two weeks.
- Every post shows a picture, and every Page can carry a picture of its own.
- Browse what is near you on Explore, as a list or on a map, with filters for type, category and date, and search the whole market.
- Follow a Page and see everything you follow in one place on You.
- Report something that does not belong; the person who posted it hears first, and serious reports go to a person.
- Pictures of children are not allowed, and reported content is hidden at once while it is looked at.

*Not yet:* repeating weekly series, asking for something we have not built, Explore ordered town by town, and a way to say you are coming.
